newsitem.title: USA: Preferred Employers names Olson COO.
newsitem.headline: Preferred Employers names Olson COO.

text.p: Preferred Employers Holdings Inc said Monday that it has named D. Mark Olson to the newly-created positions of vice-chairman and chief operating officer.
Olson previously served as president and chief executive officer of privately-held PCA Solutions Inc, a workers' compensation third party administration company.

Preferred Employers provides workers' compensation and business insurance products, risk management, and cost containment services primarily to franchised companies. It also reinsures certain workers' compensation and employers liability insurance policies through its offshore Bermuda reinsurance company.
